name: Actual Budget
insteadOf: YNAB (You Need a Budget) / Mint / Monarch Money
hook: A 100% free, local-first personal finance system with zero-based budgeting, end-to-end encryption, and multi-device sync.
bullets: Local-first architecture: all budget data lives on your device and works offline
Zero-based envelope budgeting method gives every single dollar a job
End-to-end encrypted synchronization across desktop, web, and mobile devices
Bank syncing via GoCardless and SimpleFIN, plus manual QIF, OFX, and CSV imports
benefits: Stop paying $100+/year subscription fees just to track your own money
Your financial records never get sold to advertisers or monetized by data brokers
Full speed and instant calculations with zero latency, even without an internet connection
Self-host the lightweight sync server anywhere with a single Docker container
setupSteps: Download the desktop app for Windows, macOS, or Linux, or run the web client
Create your first budget file stored securely in local SQLite storage
Set up your expense categories and income targets using envelope budgeting
Optionally launch actual-server in Docker to sync end-to-end encrypted budgets across devices
details: Actual Budget is a privacy-first, local-first personal budgeting application designed as a free, open-source successor to commercial tools like YNAB. Built with SQLite and web technologies, Actual stores your complete financial ledger directly on your device for instant, zero-latency performance offline. You can balance accounts, schedule recurring transactions, reconcile bank statements, and allocate funds using zero-based envelope budgeting. For multi-device synchronization, Actual features end-to-end client-side encryption (E2EE), meaning even if you self-host the sync server or deploy it to Fly.io or Docker, only your encryption key can read your financial data. Licensed under the permissive MIT license.
setup: App (Windows, macOS, Linux, Web) + optional Docker sync server
